events.from: Sorrel Pilkington, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, the parcel for DL-3149 was actually left in the bin store yesterday, so you can mark this closed.

Invoice BI-4742 has a £38 'wasted collection' line against DL-3149 for 28 October. Your driver turned up before our collection window even started and left. We're not paying for that. Please look into it.
Please send the collection attempt record for DL-3149 on 28 October: the booked window and the driver's arrival and departure scans. The shipper says the driver arrived before the window opened.

DL-3149: collection booked 28 October, 14:00-16:00. Arrival scan 13:52, departure scan 14:02. Driver note: 'goods not ready, nobody at goods-in'. We record the attempt. Whether a wasted-collection charge stands is for Business billing.

For your file on DL-3149: invoice BI-4742, line 3, wasted collection GBP 38.00, invoice due 4 November. A line dispute needs a written request to us with the shipment reference and the grounds; we decide within 2 working days. No dispute has been received on BI-4742. The line stands until we say otherwise.

Attached: driver-log-995.txt

The collection record for DL-3149 shows a booked window of 14:00 to 16:00, the driver's arrival scan at 13:52 and departure at 14:02, with a note that goods were not ready and nobody was at goods-in. Whether the GBP 38.00 line stands is decided by Corvane Arc's Business billing team on a written dispute. No dispute has been lodged yet. If you want me to send one, reply here and I will.

I didn't reply because I rang instead. Friday, about half three. The man I spoke to said, and I wrote it down, 'that'll be cancelled, don't worry about it'. It's now Monday, the invoice is due on the 4th and the £38 is still on it. I'm not paying it, and I'm not short-paying an invoice and getting a late mark against the account either. Honour what your colleague told me. Cancel the line and send me a corrected invoice today.
